title: SLO-tempering: introduce soft-threshold mediator and regional failback gate
author: Priya Nair
body: Motivation: production traffic spikes repeatedly tripped hard SLO circuit breakers causing noisy tenant evacuations; this PR introduces a soft-threshold mediator that allows controlled, metric-anchored SLO relaxation and a regional failback gate to avoid oscillatory rejoin storms. Summary of changes: 1) slo/mediator: add SoftThresholdMediator component that monitors per-tenant latency/availability windows, computes a temporally-weighted slack budget, and exposes decisions via a small gRPC decision API; 2) routing/failover: add RegionalFailbackGate which enforces a cooldown window and health hysteresis before allowing automatic regional rejoin, with an opt-in annotation per-tenant and a global config flag; 3) telemetry: emit new metrics (slo_mediator.slack, slo_mediator.decision_reason, regional_failback.cooldown_seconds) and tracing tags for decisions; 4) tests: unit tests for decision logic and an integration test harness simulating spike->failover->rejoin cycles; 5) docs: operator notes and rollout checklist. Implementation notes: SoftThresholdMediator calculates soft thresholds by combining recent p95 latency tail, a sliding SLO deficit window and an importance-weighted tenant score; decisions are conservative by default and require either explicit operator override or passing a high-confidence window to relax SLO enforcement. The RegionalFailbackGate uses a three-phase state machine: QUARANTINE -> PROBATION -> OPEN with exponential backoff on re-entries. Compatibility and rollout: implements feature flag (slo_soft_mediator.enabled) and a per-tenant annotation (redwood.slo/soft-temper=auto|manual|off). Default is off for existing tenants. Tests and verification: added deterministic unit tests covering edge cases (zero-traffic, constant-high-latency), fuzz test harness for decision boundaries, and a chaos integration test that ran in the canary cluster for 48h. Checklist: - [x] design doc: ENG-4217 linked - [x] telemetry & dashboards created - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] feature flag and annotation gating - [x] canary run for 48h - [x] docs and operator checklist - [x] post-merge runbook entry. Commits summary: 1) Add SoftThresholdMediator core, decision API and config scaffolding (3 commits) 2) Implement RegionalFailbackGate + routing hooks (2 commits) 3) Telemetry and dashboards + tests (1 commit) 4) Docs and rollout checklist (1 commit). Files changed (high-level): src/slo/mediator/{mediator.go, decision_test.go}, src/routing/failback/gate.go, src/routing/failback/gate_test.go, telemetry/metrics_registry.yaml, infra/feature_flags.yaml, docs/ops/slo-soft-tempering.md. Review thread (high level): Jonah Kim: "Overall looks solid; decision logic seems conservative but we should validate cost impact on canary tenants." Author reply: "Added cost impact estimate in docs and a canary annotation list; canary run targeted 5 tenants with diverse profiles." Samantha Lee: "Can we add an explicit metric that counts 'soft relaxations' per-tenant per-window?" Author: "Added slo_mediator.soft_relax_count and a dashboard panel." Marco Ruiz: "Nit: gate.go state transitions could be simplified; suggest extracting timer logic to a helper and adding comments." Author: "Refactored timers into gate_timer.go and added comments per suggestion." CI: initial lint failure on goimports fixed in second commit; unit tests passed; integration smoke test passed in canary; E2E in staging passed. Merge decision: approved by Jonah and Samantha after canary metrics reviewed, no outstanding comments. Merge method: squash and merge. Post-merge actions: - Enable feature flag in internal canary org for 7 days - Monitor slo_mediator.slack, soft_relax_count, regional_failback.cooldown_seconds and tenant error rates - Keep automated rollback window of 72h and a manual rollback playbook in docs. Release notes: "Introduce optional SLO soft-tempering mediator and regional failback gate to reduce noisy hard evacuations during transient spikes; disabled by default; requires rollout and operator review." Related tickets: ENG-4217 (design), SRE-990 (canary incident follow-up).
